title: FBI September 2023 Sighting - Serial 4
doc_notes: This document is an FBI FD-302 interview report detailing a UAP sighting by a government employee and contractors at a restricted test site.

incidents.summary: A witness observed a metallic bronze, cigar-shaped object with an intense diamond white light while driving to a test site.
incidents.quote: cigar shaped object with an extremely bright light
incidents.size: length of two or three Blackhawk helicopters
